sources.entry: JSON to Model class - Template based highly customizable macOS app to generate classes from JSON string, supports many languages.

summary.one_liner: A template-based macOS app that generates model classes from a JSON string, with built-in templates for several Swift, Java/Kotlin, Dart, C#, and Python JSON libraries.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes a JSON string as input and generates model classes from it. It ships with pre-built templates for ObjectMapper, Gloss, and Codable (Swift), GSON (Java/Kotlin), Flutter (Dart), Newtonsoft (C#), and Dataclasses (Python). The README says users can also supply their own templates, which the project describes as making the generator highly customisable. The README names SavannaKit as a dependency, which suggests it is used for the code editing view, though the README does not say what it is used for. A downloadable macOS app (v1.5) is linked from the README. The README is short and includes no usage instructions or screenshots beyond a placeholder heading.
use_cases: generate Swift Codable models from JSON
create GSON classes for Java or Kotlin from a JSON sample
produce Dart Flutter model classes from API responses
create C# Newtonsoft models from JSON
write custom code templates for JSON-to-class conversion
how_to_run: Download the macOS app (v1.5) from the link in the README
Requires macOS High Sierra 10.13 or later
notable: Template-based code generation, so output format is customizable
Pre-built templates for ObjectMapper, Gloss, Codable, GSON, Flutter, Newtonsoft, and Dataclasses
Packaged as a downloadable macOS app rather than a library
caveats: Requires macOS High Sierra 10.13 or later
README is brief and does not describe setup, usage, or build steps
The README does not state a license
